home.obove.title: What is OpenBVE?
home.obove.desc: This is the home of OpenBVE, a license-free, open source, free of charge train driving simulator. This program includes detailed per-car simulation of the brake systems, friction, air resistance, toppling and more. In 3D cabs, the driving experience is augmented with forces that shake your simulated body upon acceleration and braking, as well as in curves. Besides that, OpenBVE features a 3D positional sound system best enjoyed with surround speakers, train exteriors and timetables for the current run. Finally, via the main menu, routes and trains be easily selected to start a new session, the controls can be configured to keyboard or joystick devices, and a variety of options can be selected. Compared to other simulators of the genre, especially compared to commercial games, OpenBVE has its main focus on realism, not necessarily on user-friendliness.

about.title: About Us
about.p1: ProgressiveAddon is a dedicated content creator for train simulators, specifically focusing on OpenBVE and Trainz.
about.p2: Our mission is to provide high-quality, realistic, and accessible addons for the community. This website serves as a modern repository, migrated from our original Weebly site to ensure better performance and longevity.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.desc: We believe in open access to quality simulation content. By moving to a static-site architecture, we ensure that our downloads remain available and fast for everyone, everywhere.
